about: Things the route can't hold, shown under Deals: 'other' is other days, region-wide perks and places outside the metro; 'leads' is places with a Veterans Day deal in an earlier year and nothing for 2026 (call first; not routed or mapped). From the consolidated report of 8 Nov 2026, checked that day. Any source without a URL is cited as text only. Re-checked the night of 8 Nov 2026 against the VA, Military Wallet, American Legion and Fargo Legion Post 2 lists.

other.name: Fargo VA PatriotCafe and PatriotBrew
other.where: Fargo VA Medical Center, 2101 Elm St N, Fargo
other.offer: Free breakfast combo and free brewed coffee for veterans, no purchase (Veterans Canteen Service, at VA medical centers nationwide)
other.note: On a 2026 national list. The Fargo VA canteen's hours weren't checked.

other.name: MATBUS: free bus rides for veterans
other.where: Every Fargo and Moorhead fixed route
other.offer: Veterans ride fixed-route buses free, all year, since 11 Nov 2025. Show a veteran ID when you board.
other.note: MATBUS's fares page; its FAQ page still has the older service-connected rule.

other.name: National parks: free entry for US residents
other.where: Outside the metro: Theodore Roosevelt National Park is about 4.5 hours west
other.offer: Fee-free day at National Park Service sites for US citizens and residents. Veterans and Gold Star families can also get a free lifetime pass any day.
other.note: From 2026 news reports of the Park Service's list; check nps.gov. Camping and reservation fees still apply.

other.name: Fargo Force Honor Flight Night
other.offer: Hockey against the Sioux City Musketeers, raising money for Honor Flight of ND/MN: specialty jerseys, a band in the concourse, a giveaway and auctions. No military ticket deal announced.

other.name: Tractor Supply: 10% off for Hometown Heroes
other.where: Tractor Supply on Highway 10 at the Moorhead–Dilworth line (1411 Center Ave W, Dilworth, on OpenStreetMap)
other.offer: 10% off for verified Neighbor's Club Hometown Heroes on Veterans Day
other.note: Join Neighbor's Club and verify through ID.me before you go. On VA News' 2026 list; Tractor Supply's own release couldn't be read.

sources.publisher: VA News (VA Office of Digital Media)

other.name: Hawley High School Veterans Day program
other.where: Hawley High School gym, Hawley, MN (about 25 miles east of Moorhead)
other.offer: A Veterans Day program for veterans. The school asks veterans who plan to attend, or anyone bringing one, to contact Terri in the high school office (tgiere@hawley.k12.mn.us).
other.note: Outside the metro, so not on the route.

sources.publisher: Valley News Live (Veterans Day events planned across F-M area)
